prospects.thesis: Lockheed is the top-scored prospect with elite platform exposure (F-35, PAC-3, THAAD, hypersonics) benefiting from accelerating global defense budgets and sustained munitions replenishment demand. The +26.9% 1M move reflects institutional accumulation ahead of FY27 budget visibility, and at 1.9x P/S the valuation remains reasonable for a prime contractor. With VIX ticking up and gold rallying, defense primes offer defensive growth with a secular tailwind.

HII is the sole builder of U.S. nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and a key Virginia/Columbia-class submarine prime, giving it a monopoly-like position as naval shipbuilding gets prioritized against China peer competition. At 0.9x P/S with $12.4B cap and bullish institutional flow, HII offers a differentiated naval-exposure play separate from aerospace primes. Multi-year backlog visibility and Navy funding tailwinds make the +17.7% 1M breakout sustainable.

Leidos is a leading defense IT and digital modernization services provider, well-positioned as the Pentagon shifts spend toward AI-enabled C4ISR, cyber, and software-defined warfare. Trading at just 1.0x P/S with bullish institutional sentiment and +20.7% 1M momentum, LDOS offers a services-oriented defense exposure that diversifies away from pure hardware primes. Strong recompete win rates and expanding margin profile set up a continued re-rating.

RTX combines Raytheon missile/air defense (Patriot, LTAMDS, SM-series) with Pratt & Whitney commercial aero recovery as GTF overhaul headwinds abate. Bullish options and institutional positioning confirm smart money is building ahead of 2027 free cash flow inflection. The more measured +10% 1M move versus peers suggests relative value remains, and the diversified commercial/defense mix hedges against any budget delays.

GitLab's integrated DevSecOps platform with Duo AI code assistant is monetizing the enterprise shift toward AI-augmented software development, with public-sector FedRAMP wins providing a defense/government crossover angle. Bullish options and institutional flow suggest positioning ahead of expanding AI attach rates, but the muted +1.2% 1M and 8.2x P/S warrant patience. Adds diversification away from the defense cluster into pure-play AI software.
